name: membrane

name: late endosome
description: "A prelysosomal endocytic organelle differentiated from early endosomes by lower lumenal pH and different protein composition. name: plasma membrane
description: "The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins." [ISBN:0716731363]
